facts.fact: The HSC service checks students' identity against the eAqoonsi/NIRA ID through GovStack's Identity Verification and Consent block, per GovStack; as_of is the publication date, the document gives none.

The Central Bank of Somalia's public notice of 29 July 2025 mandates all commercial banks, from 1 September 2025, to open no new account without a valid NIRA National ID and to renew or update accounts only on confirmation of a valid NIRA ID, starting in the Banadir region.
facts.system: Commercial bank account opening and KYC (CBS eKYC regulation)

systems.system: Commercial bank account opening and KYC (CBS eKYC regulation)
systems.owner: Central Bank of Somalia with commercial banks

note: A peer-learning mission and a cooperation matrix naming e-KYC as a cooperation area; it states no Somali system checking people against the national ID.

facts.fact: UNDP Somalia reports that the Hubiye eKYC platform, formalised by Somalia's first eKYC legislation in December 2024, gives real-time identity verification across 25 integrated services including the entire commercial banking sector.
UNDP Somalia reports Hubiye eKYC verification across 25 integrated services spanning government and private sector platforms, including the whole commercial banking sector.
UNDP Somalia reports that Hubiye eKYC serves 1.2 million citizens with real-time identity verification across 25 integrated services; the document gives no event date, so its published date is used.

note: NIRA's own authentication service is the ID system itself (class other); the page mentions relying party officers but names no relying system or sector.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Somalia's prime minister directed government and private service providers in April 2025 to begin integrating the national biometric ID card for customer verification and authentication.
facts.system: Service provider customer verification against the national ID

facts.fact: A LinkedIn post by an IBS Bank mobile money head, as cited, states that financial institutions will eventually use the HUBIYE platform for biometric identity verification in KYC processes; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

The article says a World Bank Scaled-UP project paper lists reliable authentication and ID verification for financial service providers and social assistance programs among the project's deliverables; no date is given for this, so the published date is used.

The Office of the Accountant General announced in a letter of 29 August 2026 that the government payroll and SFMIS will be integrated with NIRA's national identification system to verify public employees' identity, with a pilot from 1 October 2026 and nationwide completion by 31 December 2027.
facts.system: Government payroll and Somali Financial Management Information System (SFMIS)

systems.system: Government payroll and Somali Financial Management Information System (SFMIS)
systems.owner: Office of the Accountant General, Ministry of Finance

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia says it mandated NIRA ID for opening and updating bank accounts from 1 September 2025 and that all banks are integrated to the NIRA platform.
NIRA says banks (KYC), telecoms (mandatory SIM registration), the Civil Service Commission (payroll identity verification) and the education ministry use the national ID for verification.
The Central Bank of Somalia says about 20 thousand verifications were made since September 2025, and NIRA says 100+ services are integrated.
Halmeel's director general says Halmeel is integrating its systems with NIRA's national identity database, and the national ID is the only identification accepted at its service centers.

systems.system: Halmeel unified digital government services platform

note: The document says nothing about checks against a national ID.

facts.fact: NIRA says a Prime Ministerial Directive of 21 April 2025 mandates integration of all public-facing services with the HUBIYE platform for identity verification; no service is said to be verifying yet.

note: Opinion piece describes HALMEEL's planned March 2027 platform and NIRA verification as expected; plans only, no delivered service or figure for this study.

facts.fact: NIRA says service providers verify ID credentials against its national database through Hubiye, with a provider submitting the ID number and the holder authorising by one-time password.
The document says Hubiye serves banking and public services, and UNDP counted 25 integrated services including commercial banking in May 2026.
UNDP reported in May 2026 that Hubiye served 25 integrated services and about 1.2 million citizens.

note: No other system checking against the ID is stated.

facts.fact: EUAA reports banks use NIRA electronic verification for account opening and transactions, over 23,000 verifications by March 2026.
EUAA reports verification against the NIRA ID in banking, business registration, education and transport business as of March 2026.
EUAA reports over 23,000 electronic verifications using the ID by March 2026, and more than 24 public and private services integrated by November 2025.
NIRA reports banks, notaries, microfinance and some ministries are connected to the Hubiye platform to verify people against the national ID.
NIRA's deck counts relying parties connected: 6 private and 2 public, with others in progress.

NIRA says it and the Central Bank of Somalia signed an MoU to link financial services to the National ID system, and NIRA introduced its Hubiye System for customer verification that banks and financial institutions will use.

NIRA and the National Communications Authority, meeting telecom companies on 7 September 2024, agreed to form technical committees to plan an MoU linking the National ID system with SIM registration and mobile money; no link is stated as built or in service.

note: Database line only; it states no system checking the ID.

facts.fact: UNDP says Hubiye eKYC verifies identity in real time across 25 integrated services including the entire commercial banking sector.
UNDP reports Hubiye eKYC serves 1.2 million citizens across 25 integrated services.
NIRA and the Somali Bankers Association signed a partnership agreement to integrate the national ID system with the banking sector.
BMZ Digital.Global says the HSC verifies students against the national digital ID via eAqoonsi (NIRA) to retrieve exam results; the HSC launched by 27 March 2025.
